Solara — (9.1) NOVA

HOLLOW ENCOUNTER

"That is not The Hollow"

[Verse 1]

Level nine

We have been tracking it since Level 5

(it moves like it knows we’re following)

(because it does)

The Hunter has his bow ready this time

The Hero has a speech prepared

The Queen has said nothing for two levels

Which means she’s ready

Aldric says we’re close

(how close)

Very close

(how close is very close)

Turn left

[Pre-Chorus]

We turned left

And then we saw it

(…)

(that’s…)

(is that…)

(Aldric)

(…)

(ALDRIC)

[Chorus]

That is not The Hollow

(it is definitely not The Hollow)

That is a swan

(technically yes)

Doing what I think is a pirouette

(third position actually)

On Level Nine

In the middle of the cosmos

With an audience of none

Until now

[Verse 2]

He stops

He turns

He looks at us the way someone looks

When they’ve been expecting company

(he was expecting company)

(ALDRIC)

I was not expecting company

I was perfecting the finale

The Hunter lowers his bow

The Hero puts the speech away

Castor starts to say something warm

The Queen puts her hand on his arm

Not yet

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Aldric clears his throat

(the map)

Yes

(it said exactly this)

It said we would find something that escaped The Hollow’s path

(you said the map was wrong)

I said the map was UNUSUAL

(those are different things)

They are very different things yes

[Chorus 2]

This is not The Hollow

(this is better)

(debatable)

This is a swan who survived something

(or avoided it)

(same result)

Who moves like he’s performing

For a theater that doesn’t exist yet

And he is looking at us

Like we are the theater

[Bridge]

He says he has been traveling Level 9 for longer than we have been a crew

He says he knows where things go quiet

And where they go very loud

He says he can read the cosmos the way water reads stone

Slowly and completely

He says —

I would like to come with you

I look at my crew

The Hunter shrugs

(he’s graceful at least)

The Hero nods

(for protection obviously)

(the group needs grace)

Castor is already smiling

The Queen is watching The Swan the way she watches everything

Like she already knows the answer

And is waiting for me to catch up

[Final Chorus]

This is not The Hollow

This is something better

This is a swan on Level Nine

Who chose to stop running

And chose us instead

I haven’t said yes yet

But I’m not walking away either

[Outro]

He finishes the pirouette

Lands perfectly

Looks at me

(well?)

Well

We have six levels to think about it

(third position)

(I know)
